an4.187:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
an4.187:1.2: athakho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.187:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

an4.187:4.1: ekamidaṃ bho gotama samayaṃ todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa parisati parupārambhaṃ vattenti
an4.187:4.2: bālo ayaṃ rājā eḷeyyo yo samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasanno samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karoti yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ
an4.187:4.4: yamako moggallo uggo nāvinākī gandhabbo aggivesso ye samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammanti
an4.187:4.5: tyassudaṃ todeyyo brāhmaṇo iminā nayena neti
an4.187:4.7: paṇḍito rājā eḷeyyo karaṇīyādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīyādhivacanīyesu alamatthadasatarehi alamatthadasataroti
